messages:
nate: Heads-up — hitting a credential-rotation prompt loop running `redwoodctl auth rotate` on my macbook (macOS 13, zsh). It opens the browser, I complete SSO, but CLI still asks to authenticate and repeats.

lisa: Can you paste the command output and any stderr? :thinking_face:

nate: ```
$ redwoodctl auth rotate
Rotating credentials...
Please complete SSO in browser
Opening browser...
... browser confirms ...
Failed to write credential: permission denied "~/.redwood/credentials"
Retrying...
Please complete SSO in browser
```

ahmed: Sounds like a file permission issue. Run `ls -la ~/.redwood` and paste results. Did you ever install with `sudo`?

nate: yep i used sudo the first time during a quick test last week. ls shows `drwxr-x--- 2 root staff 4096 Jun 10 10:01 .redwood`

dev-bot: Rotation job #453 failed: write error -> EACCES on /home/nate/.redwood/credentials

lisa: That explains it. Workaround: `sudo chown $(whoami):$(whoami) ~/.redwood -R` then re-run `redwoodctl auth login` (or `--token` if you have a PAT). :thumbsup:

nate: ok `chown` fixed it — rotation completed. thanks!

ahmed: We should not have installer create root-owned config. I'll open a GH issue and a postinstall migration. Assigning to @ahmed. Also add safe-fallback: if write fails, show clear message with exact path + suggestion.

lisa: Can you include OS, redwoodctl version and how installer was invoked in the issue? We'll tag DEVEX-4321 and add a small e2e for installer on mac/linux.

nate: adding: macOS 13.4, redwoodctl 0.11.2, installer run with `sudo sh install.sh` (user accidentally used sudo).

ahmed: Note: WSL users reported mixed perms when running from both Windows installer and WSL. We'll include a postinstall `chown` step for non-root users and check umask logic.

lisa: Great. For immediate DX we should update docs to warn against `sudo` and show the `chown` recovery.

nate: filed a quick comment in DEVEX-4321 with logs and the `ls -la` output. :zap:

dev-bot: Pinned follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4321

lisa: thanks all — moving to GH. If anyone else hits this, drop the output here and we'll triage quickly. :pray:
